mechanism_narrative: A high level of residential fixed investment (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which correlates with robust corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances with RSAFS above the 5-year average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces corporate borrowing and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate deteriorating labor market conditions, which predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a sustained high federal funds rate compresses corporate profit growth and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals economic weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions, which correlates with rising consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with PAYEMS above the 5-year average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal robust economic activity across manufacturing and construction sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO and HOUST both exceed their 3-month averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 110) signals weakening economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 110 during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
